hypotheses.mechanism: The immediate BASE blocker is a mismatch between admitted current G9 surface constructs and grammar/parser coverage, not evidence that the semantic IR lacks the concepts.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Minimal frontend additions for comparisons, conditional blocks and typed interface methods parse/canonicalize current admitted snippets without changing effect-authority semantics.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: grammar.ebnf is only descriptive and a newer authoritative parser already accepts the constructs.
hypotheses.falsifier: A current authoritative parser/compiler accepts the exact checked snippets, produces deterministic canonical IR and executes/lower them with matching receipts without grammar change.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Run the exact snippets through the actual CC-WP-02 parser once located/built; differential-check canonical hashes and diagnostics.

hypotheses.mechanism: Research declarations such as hypothesis/experiment/falsifier can remain meta-dialect or research-envelope constructs instead of inflating the executable core grammar.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Runtime/compiler acceptance applications do not require these declarations to lower as executable operations; meta tooling can preserve them with provenance separately.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Self-research and Clay-native compiler tooling require first-class executable meta declarations in the same grammar to preserve semantic identity and transformations.
hypotheses.falsifier: A required BASE application or FRANK/Harness path cannot preserve/transform/execute necessary research semantics unless these declarations are first-class core IR operations.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Build the compiler/tool exemplar twice: meta-envelope versus first-class meta ops; compare expressibility, canonical identity, complexity and roundtrip loss.

hypotheses.mechanism: A typed component-style ABI can serve as one ClayCode host-interoperability backend while keeping capability/authority outside model text.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Clay semantic signatures can lower to typed resource/interface boundaries for HTTP/files/async without ambient authority, while Ubuntu-native lowering remains available for unsupported paths.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Component/WASI lowering adds boundary complexity and ecosystem constraints without improving the Ubuntu v0.1 acceptance suite over a native host ABI.
hypotheses.falsifier: HTTP/concurrency/system-effect exemplars show higher semantic leakage, missing features or unacceptable overhead versus native typed FFI under matched tests.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Compile APP-02 and APP-04 through native-host and WASI-component adapters; compare semantic receipts, capability scope, latency and implementation cost.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dependency/effect/authority/provenance/hyperposition signatures should be compiler products of canonical IR, avoiding a second hand-maintained semantic graph.
hypotheses.expected_observation: Compiler-derived signatures can drive incremental UnifiedDB invalidation and ClayGraph projection with fewer drift mismatches than manually maintained graph metadata.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Runtime-only observation plus database triggers are simpler and equally accurate; compiler dependency extraction adds complexity without useful hot-path savings.
hypotheses.falsifier: Differential tests show compiler signatures miss dynamic dependencies or fail to improve correctness/latency versus runtime-only baselines.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Implement dependency signatures for a small DB-backed concurrent service and compare static+runtime versus runtime-only invalidation/graph accuracy.

hypotheses.mechanism: FRANK v0.1 adaptive visual learner state can be represented with existing generic G9 records, deltas, provenance/evidence, epochs, status variants, budgets and rollback references.
hypotheses.expected_observation: A frozen H1 Micro Visual Classifier state machine maps into canonical ClayCode IR without dedicated visual-learning primitives or opaque semantic escape hatches.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Calibration/open-set/version migration or bounded online update semantics require a missing language-level construct that generic records/effects cannot preserve deterministically.
hypotheses.falsifier: H1 produces a concrete learner transition that cannot be typed, replayed, rolled back or differentially represented without new semantics.
hypotheses.cheapest_test: Encode MVC admission/update/promotion/rollback state machine as a BASE FRANK-component exemplar and run H1-style golden transitions.
